I sat down with Roger, the developer behind the #1 app on the App Store, not once, but twice. In this podcast, Roger breaks down his full journey through app development, sharing how he went from idea to launch to dominating the charts. If you're curious about mobile app development, need a real-world app development roadmap, or just want to know how to make an app that wins, this conversation is packed with value.

Roger shares deep insights into coding, how he approached app development for beginners, and his path as a software developer. We dive into programming, the realities of software development, and what it takes to succeed in full stack development. Whether you're working on your next business idea or just want to understand the business model behind successful apps, Roger lays it all out.

He also talks about how to develop an app, how to create an app, and how to generate and test strong app ideas. If you're hunting for new business ideas, best business ideas, or want to hear from someone who's actually done it, don’t miss this episode.
